delta: # Story — TICKETS-2-WEB ag

ent — I filter and sort the queue; an agent sees all of it (Story: CRM-74)

## Prerequisites

- `TICKETS-1-API` complet
ed and shipped. `GET /api/v1/tickets` already accepts `status`, `priority`, `categoryId`, `assigneeId`, `sort`, `limit`, and `offset` query parameters, returns
`{ items, total, offset, limit }`, and refuses (does not clamp) a `limit` above the ceiling. This story consumes that endpoint ver

batim.
- `TICKETS-1-WEB` (CRM-72) — the raise-ticket page — is the sibling story that already wired ticket types and error

-code plumbing into `web/`. Follow the same wiring where it applies, but do not depend on it: the queue is a read-only page.
- Read
`.squad/plan-lessons.md` end-to-end before writing code. Recurring defects listed there apply directly (L
-30 — a `Response` body can be read once; strings written in components; whole pages using `useState`

where `useSearchParams` belongs).
- Coordinate with no one on the API side — the intake

states **no `api/` changes**. Do not add fields, do not "improve" the query shape, do not turn `none` into `null`.

---

## Story

Goal

Give an agent a paginated, filterable, sortable ticket queue at `/tickets` (name aligned with the existing customers route p

attern in `web/src/app/routes.tsx`), fully driven by `GET /api/v1/tickets`. Concretely:

1. Filter controls for **status**, **priority**,
**category**, and **assignee** (with an explicit "unassigned" choice) plus a **sort** control. Every change is a new request; n

othing is filtered client-side over cached rows.
2. Filters and the current page live in the URL via `react-router`'s `useSearchPar

ams`. Reloading the page returns the same rows.
3. Loading / error / empty / success are the same four states the customers

page renders, using the same primitives from `web/src/shared/ui/`.
4. The empty state names the active filters and offers to clear them (

D-2).
5. Every user-visible string is added to both `web/src/shared/i18n/en.ts` and `web/src/shared/i18n/ar.ts` in the same edit.

Expl
icitly **out of scope** (per intake): raising a ticket, assigning from the queue, a detail screen, saved filters, any

`api/` change.

---

## Context — Read These Files First

1. `web/src/pages/customers/CustomersPage.tsx` (~lines 1–153) — the pattern to copy. Note
the four-state render off `useRequest`'s `status` (see the `busy`, `status === 'error'`, `status === 'success'
&& shown.length === 0`, `status === 'success' && shown.length > 0 && page` branches around lines 44–150), the empty-state `action` that resets and re
-searches (lines 96–115), and the paging buttons using `page.offset` / `page.total` (lines 131–148). The new page must render the same sk

eleton/error/empty/list layout — do **not** invent a second page shape.
2. `web/src/pages/customers/useCustomerSearch.ts` — the sh
ape of a page-level data hook that returns `{ status, page, error, query, search }` and exports a `PAGE_SI

ZE` constant. The queue's hook mirrors this shape but reads its inputs from the URL, not from a local `search(...)` call.
3. `web/src/pages/
customers/CustomersPage.test.tsx` — the test style to copy: Vitest, `renderWithProviders` with `{ signedIn: true }`, stubbed `

fetch` returning fresh `Response` objects per call, an `ar` render for RTL/i18n coverage.
4. `web/src/p
ages/customers/CustomersPage.css` — the class-name style to copy (`customer-list`, `customer-list__row`, `customer-list__contact`). Add a par

allel `ticket-queue` set; do **not** reuse `customer-list__*`.
5. `web/src/shared/hooks/useRequest.ts` — the four-state (
`idle | loading | error | success`) hook. Every page uses this; the queue hook wraps it, it does not re-impl

ement it.
6. `web/src/shared/api/client.ts` and `web/src/shared/api/errors.ts` — the `apiRequest` helper and `ApiErrorCode` union. Error
text is keyed by `code` — copy the pattern that `CustomersPage.tsx` line 90 uses (`t.errors[error.code as keyof typeof t.errors] ?? t

.errors.INTERNAL`). Do **not** compose sentences from `fields`.
7. `web/src/shared/ui/index.ts` — the primitives export barrel (`Button`, `Card`, `E
mptyState`, `ErrorState`, `Field`, `Heading`, `Input`, `Select`, `Skeleton`, `Stack`, `Text`, `TextArea`). Use `Select` for the filter/sort controls; if it lacks a need

ed prop, extend it — do not swap in a native `<select>` styled inline.
8. `web/
src/shared/i18n/en.ts` and `web/src/shared/i18n/ar.ts` — every string this page renders must land in both. Add a `
t.ticketQueue` namespace (parallel to `t.customers`). The Arabic strings must be real translations, not English copied across; `scripts/verify-i18n-parity.m

js` fails on key parity, and a human reads the rest.
9. `web/src/app/routes.tsx` — the route table. Add

a new authenticated route for the queue next to the existing `CustomersPage` entry (see line 7 and line 36 for the pattern).
10. `web/src/testing/render.tsx` — `renderWithPro
viders`. Note whether it already mounts `react-router`; if it does, `useSearchParams` works out of the box. If it does not, the test must wrap in a `Memo

ryRouter` with the initial URL.
11. `api/src/features/tickets/tickets.rules.js` — grep for `UNASSIGNED` to confirm the exact sentinel token used by the API

. The URL param this screen sends is `assigneeId=none`; an empty string or a missing parameter both mean "do not filter by assignee".
12. `api/src/
features/tickets/tickets.routes.js` and `api/src/features/tickets/tickets.repository.js` — read only far enough to confirm the accepted values for

`status`, `priority`, `sort`, and the `limit` ceiling. Do **not** change either file.
13. `scripts/criteria/tickets.md` (section `TICKETS-2-WEB`) —

the five acceptance criteria are the source of truth for the Done Criteria checklist below.
14. `scripts/verify-i18n-parity.mjs` — read the head

comment so the test loop below reflects what it actually enforces.
15. Grep `useSearchParams` across `web/src/` before writing — if a hel

per already wraps it, use the helper.

---

## Product rules (from story)

- **BR-4 — No unboun
ded list:** paginated, filterable, sortable, with a maximum page size. This screen owns BR-4 on the web side. It never asks for more than the API's

ceiling and never renders more than one page at a time.
- **BR-6 — No hardcoded strings:** every user-visible string comes from `

en.ts` and `ar.ts`, both edited in the same commit.
- **D-2 — Empty states name the next action:** the empty state lists which

filters are active and offers a single button to clear them.

---

## Frontend Tasks

### 1 — Route

**File:** `web/src/app/routes.tsx`

- Import a

new `TicketQueuePage` from `../pages/tickets/TicketQueuePage` next to the existing `CustomersPage` import.
- Register `/tickets` (path

aligned with `/customers`) as an authenticated route using the same `RequireAuth` wrapper the existing routes use.
- Do **not** tou

ch unrelated routes.

### 2 — URL-driven data hook

**Create file:** `web/src/pages/tickets/useTicketQueue.ts`

- Export `PAGE_SIZE` (a const
ant ≤ the API ceiling — confirm the ceiling in `api/src/features/tickets/tickets.repository.js` before choosing a value; if the ceiling is 50,

pick 25).
- Export a `TicketQueueFilters` type with fields: `status?: TicketStatus`, `priority?: TicketPriority`, `categoryId?: string`, `assigneeId?: string | 'none'`, `sort?: string`

, `offset: number`.
- Read every filter from `useSearchParams()` (`react-router`). **Do not** hold filters in `useState`.
- On mount and whenever any of

the URL params change, call `useRequest` with a call to `apiRequest('/api/v1/tickets', { query: <derived from params> })`.
-

Serialise `assigneeId === 'none'` as the literal string `none` in the query. Omit the param entirely for "do not filter by assignee" (the default).
- Return `{ status, page, error,
filters, setFilters, goToOffset, clearFilters }`. `setFilters` writes to `useSearchParams` (`setSearchParams`,

replacing empty values) — it never sets local state that shadows the URL.
- `clearFilters` calls `setSearchParams

/tickets.rules.js` and `tickets.repository.js` before writing — do not invent values the API rejects.)

### 3 — Page component

**Create file:** `web/src/pages/t

ickets/TicketQueuePage.tsx`

- Follow the shape of `web/src/pages/customers/CustomersPage.tsx` (lines 31–153) exactly:
  - `

useTranslation()`, `useFormatters()`, hook (`useTicketQueue()`).
  - Header `<Heading level={2}>{t.ticketQueue.title}

</Heading>`.
  - A `<Stack as="form" direction="row" gap={2} align="end">` for the filters. Each control is
a `Field`+`Select` from `web/src/shared/ui/`. On `onSubmit`, prevent default and call `setFilters(...)` — the UR

L change re-triggers the request.
  - The "assignee" filter's options include a `t.ticketQueue.filters

.assigneeUnassigned` choice whose value is the string `'none'`. Plain empty string means "any".
  - A "sort" `Select`.
- Four-state render: `Skeleton` when `busy`, `ErrorState` on `error` (body via `t.errors[error.code] ?? t.errors.INTERNAL`), `EmptyState` on

empty success, list + paging on non-empty success.
  - **Empty state must name active filters.** Compose
a summary string by joining the humanised filter labels from `t.ticketQueue.filters.*` and pass it as `body`. The `action` is a single `Button` that calls `clearFilters()`; its

label is `t.ticketQueue.emptyAction`.
  - Result count text uses `formatNumber(page.total)` and `t.ticketQueue.resultCount`.
  - Row
component renders `id`, `subject`, `status`, `priority`, `assignee`, `updatedAt` (verify the field names on the API response by grepping `tickets.

repository.js` for the `SELECT` list before naming them).
  - Paging buttons use `page.offset === 0` and `page.offset + page.items.length >= page.total` for

`disabled`, exactly like `CustomersPage.tsx` lines 134 and 143. On click, call `goToOffset(...)`, which writes the new offset into the URL.
- **Do not** fil

ter, sort, or slice `page.items` inside the component. Whatever the API returned is what the screen shows.

### 4 — Page CSS

**Create file

:** `web/src/pages/tickets/TicketQueuePage.css`

- Add `ticket-queue`, `ticket-queue__row`, `ticket-queue__meta` classes. Do not import `

customer-list__*` classes into the ticket page; they are meaningfully different tables.

### 5 — Translations

**File:** `web/src/shared/i18n/en.ts`

- Add a `

ticketQueue` namespace:
  - `title`
  - `filters.status`, `filters.statusAny`, and one label per accepted status
  - `filters.priority`, `filters.priorityAny`

, and one label per accepted priority
  - `filters.category`, `filters.categoryAny`
  - `filters.assignee`, `filters.assigneeAny`, `filters.assigneeUnassigned`
  - `filters.sort`, and one label per accepted sort
  - `filters.ap

ply`, `filters.clear`
  - `resultCount`, `previous`, `next`
  - `errorTitle`
  - `emptyTitle`, `emptyBodyWithFilters` (a format string that tak

es the joined filter summary), `emptyAction`
  - `columns.id`, `columns.subject`, `columns.status`, `columns.priority`, `columns.assignee`, `columns.updatedAt`
  - `un

assigned` (for the row-level display when `assignee` is null)

**File:** `web/src/shared/i18n/ar.ts`

- Add the **exact same key set** with real Arabic translations. `
scripts/verify-i18n-parity.mjs` fails on any key present in one file and missing from the other; there is no other check for translation quality, so the str

ings must be written by hand and not left as English placeholders.

### 6 — No new API code

**No backend changes required.** The que
ue endpoint already accepts every filter this screen uses. If a filter cannot be expressed with the existing `status`, `priority`, `categoryId`, `ass

igneeId`, `sort`, `limit`, `offset` params, the filter is out of scope for this story — do not extend the API.

---

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

-
**Unknown filter value in the URL** (e.g. someone edits `?status=banana`): the hook must pass it through to the API and let the API respond with `VALIDATION_F
AILED`. The `ErrorState` branch renders the code-keyed message; do **not** silently drop unknown values in the browser. Enforced in `useTicketQueue.ts` (no value-sc

rubbing).
- **`assigneeId=none` vs missing:** `none` sends `assigneeId=none`, "any" omits the parameter. Empty-string in the URL is tre

ated as "any". Enforced in the URL → query serialiser in `useTicketQueue.ts`.
- **Reload with fil

ters in the URL:** on first mount the hook must fire the request from the URL, not from defaults. Test explicitly (see Test Plan #4).
- **Second
read of a stubbed `Response`** (L-30): every test that mocks `fetch` builds a fresh `Response` per call. A shared `Response` object f

ails on the second render pass.
- **`limit` above the ceiling:** `PAGE_SIZE` must be ≤ the API ceiling defined in `api/src/features/tickets/tickets

.repository.js`. If the ceiling changes, this constant is the single point of update.
- **Empty result with filters c
leared:** the empty state still renders; `emptyBodyWithFilters` receives an empty summary and falls back to a generic body. Enforced in `TicketQueuePage.tsx`'

s empty branch.
- **RTL:** the filter row and paging buttons must reverse in Arabic. `

Stack` already handles logical properties; do not add `left`/`right` in `TicketQueuePage.css`.
- **`total === 0` with `offset >

0`:** paging Previous is enabled (offset > 0) but Next is disabled. Clicking Previous walks back to page one. Do not special-case this.
- **UR
L history:** filter changes push a new history entry (an agent should be able to Back to their prior filter). Pa

ging replaces it (Back should go to their prior filter, not their prior page).
- **Sort default:** if `

sort` is absent from the URL, the hook omits the param and the API applies its own default. Do not send a client-side default.

---

## Test Plan

Add or ext
end the following. Match the style of `web/src/pages/customers/CustomersPage.test.tsx` (Vitest, Testing Library, `renderWithProviders` from `web

/src/testing/render.tsx`).

1. **Unit — `web/src/pages/tickets/TicketQueuePage.test.tsx` — first render fires a
request with URL filters.** Mount at `/tickets?status=open&assigneeId=none` (wrap in `MemoryRouter` with `initialEntries` if `

renderWithProviders` does not already mount a router). Assert `fetch` was called with a URL whose query includes `status=open` and `assigneeId=none`.
2. **Unit — same
file — changing a filter fires a new request and does not filter cached rows.** Seed the stub to return two different pages for two different `status` values. Change

the filter; assert the second render calls the API and shows the new rows, not a client-filtered subset of the first.
3. **Unit — same file — empty state names filters and offers to clear.** St
ub the API to return `{ items: [], total: 0, offset: 0, limit: 25 }` with `?status=open&priority=urgent` in the URL. Assert the
empty-state body includes the status and priority labels; click the clear button and assert the URL params are gone and a new request was fired without

them.
4. **Unit — same file — reload preserves rows.** Render at `/tickets?status=pending&offset=25`, assert the request has both params.
5. **Un
it — same file — paging uses API offsets.** Assert Next is disabled when `offset + items.length >= total`, Previous disabled at `offset === 0`, click Next and assert URL contains `offset=25` (

or whatever `PAGE_SIZE` resolves to) and a request went out.
6. **Unit — same file — error state renders code-keyed message.** Stub the API to return `{ code: 'VALIDATION_FAIL

ED', fields: [...] }` at HTTP 400; assert `t.errors.VALIDATION_FAILED` is on screen and the retry button re-fires the same request.
7. **Un
it — same file — Arabic render.** `renderWithProviders(<TicketQueuePage />, { signedIn: true, language: 'ar' })` — assert the Arabic title, filter labels, and empty-state text render (

mirrors `CustomersPage.test.tsx` line 168).
8. **Unit — `web/src/pages/tickets/useTicketQueue.test.ts`** — dire
ct hook tests: URL → query mapping, `assigneeId=none` special case, `clearFilters` empties the URL, `goToOffset` uses `replace:

true` on history but `setFilters` uses `push`.
9. **Integration — `web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts`** — extend the existing s
weep to include the new `web/src/pages/tickets/*.tsx` files (or verify the existing pattern already covers them). Every visible string must come from `t.*

`.
10. **I18n parity — no new test file needed.** `scripts/verify-i18n-parity.mjs` will fail automatically if `en.ts` and `ar.ts` are

edited unevenly. Run it in Verification below.
11. **Do not** modify `api/**` tests. If a new API

-side test is called for, the intake is wrong — stop and escalate.

---

## Ver

ification Steps

1. **Frontend runs:** `cd web && npm test` — new tests green, existing tests still green. Vitest is the whole suite.
2. **
Frontend builds:** `cd web && npm run build` — `tsc -b && vite build` must succeed. The web suite does **not** typecheck via `npm test`; a change only vitest has

seen is not verified.
3. **I18n parity:** `node scripts/verify-i18n-parity.mjs` (or the npm script that wraps it, if one

exists — grep `verify-i18n-parity` in `package.json` files to find it) — must exit 0.
4. **Backend untouched:** `git diff --stat api/` retur

ns empty. If it does not, revert.
5. **No AI attribution:** `git grep -Ei 'ai-generated|copilot|chatgpt|assisted by' -
- ':!.squad/' ':!package-lock.json'` returns empty. Include this ex

act command in the PR description.
6. **Regression:** `cd web && npm test -- CustomersPage` and `cd web && npm test -- SignInPage` still green (shared primitives and error m

apping unchanged).
7. **Manual smoke:** `cd web && npm run dev`, sign in, open `/tickets`, apply a filter, reload, hit

Back, share the URL. All five acceptance criteria demonstrable by hand.

---

## Done Criteria

- [ ] `TicketQueuePage` renders at `/tickets`

behind auth; filter changes issue a new `GET /api/v1/tickets` and the screen does not filter rows it already holds.
- [ ] Empty state

names the currently applied filters and offers a single "clear filters" button (D-2).
- [ ] Paging is driven entirely by the API's `total` / `offset` / `lim

it`; `PAGE_SIZE` ≤ the API ceiling; no client-side slicing.
- [ ] Filters and offset live in the URL via

`useSearchParams`; reload returns the same rows; a copied URL reproduces the view.
- [ ] Every user-visible string comes from `web/src/shared/i18

n/en.ts` and `web/src/shared/i18n/ar.ts`; `scripts/verify-i18n-parity.mjs` exits 0.
- [ ] `cd web && npm test` and `cd web && npm run build` both p

ass.
- [ ] `git diff --stat api/` is empty.
- [ ] No commit, comment, doc, or ignore-file entry mentions AI assistance (gr

ep in Verification #5 returns empty).
